title: [MTR4] StarTrain A435
description: [4.5K Download Special!] Adds a fictional train, the StarTrain A435, to MTR4.
body:
The StarTrain A435 is a subway train, the first batch, originally called the D68, built in 1993 and entered service into San Marvin in 1995. Some trains were eventually modernized in 2008 and its name was officially changed to A435.

This pack adds the StarTrain A435 to Minecraft. It requires MTR version 4.0.4 for it to work properly. In order to get the sounds for the train, you'll need the S43-Tec LRT pack which can be downloaded in the S43 Discord server, but if you don't, you can add your own sounds to the train.

Feel free to modify this any way you like!
